title: Literature-bound FMC surface-front and falling-slug kinematics preflight
purpose: Qualify the published FMC/SMVE surface-process kinematics before implementing supply-limited finite-volume activation, slug collision/merging, redistribution bookkeeping, or any SWAP trajectory comparator.

predecessor_authority.D12: FMC/SMVE equation preflight passed; 200 bins and maximum 10 s explicit process step frozen before SWAP trajectory evidence.
predecessor_authority.D13: FMC_GW200 groundwater-front branch retained research candidacy and beat matched R2 in the bounded capillary-fringe relaxation envelope.
predecessor_authority.implication: D14 tests the distinct atmospheric-side front kinematics without changing D12 discretization or using D13 outcomes to tune them.

primary_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
primary_authority.role: improved infiltration-front equation 18, falling-slug equation 19, capillary relaxation, finite-volume accounting

primary_authority.citation: Talbot and Ogden (2008), A method for computing infiltration and redistribution in a discretized moisture content domain
primary_authority.role: finite-water-content surface supply/front-activation precedent; D14 does not yet implement the full allocation algorithm

primary_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2017), The Soil Moisture Velocity Equation
primary_authority.role: SMVE derivation and advection-like physical interpretation

discretization.constitutive_sample: right edge of each theta bin

infiltration_front.reservoir_semantics: unlimited synthetic surface reservoir; D14 measures water demand but does not implement rainfall supply allocation
infiltration_front.capillary_relaxation: sort front depths descending after the explicit step; sorting may change bin/front association but must not change dtheta*sum(z)
infiltration_front.physical_requirement: 0 < z_j <= 160 cm before and after relaxation

infiltration_profiles.construction: linear in bin index from z_101=20 cm to z_199=2 cm
linear in bin index from z_101=60 cm to z_199=5 cm
linear in bin index from z_101=120 cm to z_199=10 cm
linear in bin index from z_101=1.0 cm to z_199=0.1 cm
infiltration_profiles.role: prospectively selected constitutive-only stress case that produces pre-relaxation front overtaking under the frozen 10 s step

falling_slug.interpretation: gravity-only falling-slug translation; upper and lower slug interfaces for the same bin move at identical v_j
falling_slug.synthetic_state: for each j=101..199, slug top depth = 20 + 0.1*(j-101) cm and slug length = 5 cm
falling_slug.storage_identity: dtheta*(bottom-top) is unchanged for every bin and in total

tests.requirement: For all four frozen profiles, every Eq.18 velocity and raw/relaxed front depth is finite and physical; finite-volume surface-water demand is positive.

For every profile, sorting restores/retains monotone front ordering and changes dtheta*sum(z) by <=1e-14 cm. I_RELAX must contain at least one raw front-order inversion before sorting so relaxation is actually exercised.
With an unlimited synthetic reservoir, withdrawn surface water equals the finite-volume column storage increment to <=1e-14 cm; no correction flux is permitted.
All 99 falling-slug bin velocities are finite and positive, both slug interfaces remain inside 0..160 cm after 10 s, and maximum absolute slug-length change is <=1e-14 cm.
Total finite-volume slug water dtheta*sum(length_j) is unchanged by the Eq.19 translation to <=1e-14 cm.

D15_gate.if_positive: Authorize D15 only to reconcile and preflight the remaining finite-volume surface accounting: supply-limited bin activation, dry-bin initiation, falling-slug creation/collision/groundwater merge, and redistribution bookkeeping. A SWAP infiltration comparator is not authorized until that accounting preflight passes.
D15_gate.if_negative: Close the FMC atmospheric-side route without changing bin count, substep, equations, or synthetic profiles.
